clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 万斯称伊朗协议是美方双赢

subtitles.en: The part of the peace plan, the part of this MOU that I think have been most misrepresented by certain parts of the media is the idea that the Iranians get
subtitles.zh: 和平计划中，部分媒体最曲解的一点是伊朗能获得所有好处。

subtitles.en: all these benefits. You will hear things about $300 billion or $24 billion.
subtitles.zh: 你会听到3000亿或240亿美元的说法。

subtitles.en: Or this for that number of money or amount of money. And the simple fact is that the only way the Iranians get any of those resources, not a single penny by the way
subtitles.zh: 事实是，伊朗要拿到任何资金——注意，美国一分钱都不会出——

subtitles.en: from the United States of America, under any circumstances.
But the only way that they would ever get any benefit of the bargain is if they comply fully and change their behavior. And so you really have a win-win situation
subtitles.zh: 他们获得好处的唯一方式是全面履约并改变行为。所以这对美国是双赢。

subtitles.en: for the United States of America. If the Iranians don't change their behavior, their military and their nuclear program is still destroyed.
subtitles.zh: 如果伊朗不改变行为，其军事和核计划仍被摧毁。

subtitles.en: If they do change their behavior, then they are going to have a transformative relationship with the Middle East and the Middle East will have a transformative
subtitles.zh: 如果改变，他们将与中东建立变革性关系，中东也将与伊朗人民建立变革性关系。

subtitles.en: relationship with the people of Iran. That's a win for the American people and for the President of the United States, regardless of which option the
subtitles.zh: 无论伊朗最终选择哪条路，这对美国人民和总统都是胜利。
